dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: If only I could go home soon...

dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: Ah, greetings, Honorary Knight. I was just talking to myself, please don't mind me.

dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: But of course, I would be lying if I said I didn't miss home. I miss the smell of the delicious food at Good Hunter, the afternoons in Springvale, the gentle breeze over Cider Lake, and the dandelions drifting on the breeze... How could I not feel nostalgic?

dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: I'm not like Nannina, I'm not as strong as she is. But please don't worry, Honorary Knight. No matter how much I miss home, I will perform my duties to the best of my ability.

dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: After all, we're all on this expedition in order to defend Mondstadt... Our Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Laurent
dialogues.text: See you, Honorary Knight, and may the West Wind guide you on your journey home.
